title: FortressAuth IT113 Phase 4 Step 4 - Local Failure and Recovery
data_origin: synthetic payload, isolated temporary PHP data
network_scope: 127.0.0.1 only; no Supabase or remote hosts

checks.check: ML API refuses startup with an unset token
PHP rejects insecure remote HTTP ML URLs
Offline ML predictions are queued once without blocking PHP
Outage queue contains one synthetic pending item
Failed replay retains item with a retry backoff
Recovered real ML server responds on loopback
PHP detects ML token disagreement without accepting a prediction
Recovered service replays and clears the pending snapshot
Recovered prediction retains trace, evidence and non-blocking history
PHP handles HTTP 503 without accepting a prediction
Slow ML response is bounded by the PHP timeout
Deterministic policy remains configured; AI enforcement stays advisory
Service status evidence excludes secrets and destination URL

limitations: Actual Supabase/PostgreSQL queue persistence and recovery were not tested.
A full deployed PHP session, security middleware and administrator UI were not exercised.
Timeouts and malformed responses were exercised with a loopback negative-response fixture.
Results are a controlled local integration test, not a production penetration test.
